book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mataayo

content: Obhukuru bhwa Yeesu bhurarorekana iguru we ekiguru
Hano zyahitiri eziisiku isaasabha, Yeesu akagega Petero, Yaakobo na Yohana, akatiira nabho mukiguru ekitaambi, kibhezo.
Hano bhaari hayo, Yeesu akakyoorwa embere waabhu. Obhusyo bhwaaye bhukabhara kyeego eryoobha ne eziingibho zyaaye zikabha ndabhu bhukongʼu kyo obhweero.
Hayohayo, bhakatuukira Musa na Eriya
bhakabha bharakeerenia neewe.

Niho Petero akamubhuurira Yeesu, “Ee Omukuru, ni kisi etwe kubha hano. Eraabhe oriikirirya, ndoomboka hano ebhihuuna bhitatu. Ekimwe kibhe ekyaazo, ekiindi kibhe kya Musa, ne ekiindi kibhe kya Eriya.”

Hano Petero yaakyagaamba, kituukiro, eriisaaro rikiituuma riramesya no okubhakuundikirya. Kyaamwe bhakiigwa eriiraka okurwa mwiisaaro riyo rirabhuga, “Wuno niwe Omwaana waane omuseegwa, nizomereerwe neewe. Mubhe muramwiitegeerera!”
Hano abhaanabheega bhaaye bhiigwiiri gayo, bhakoobhoha bhukongʼu, bhakahigama haasi bhubhuumari.
Yeesu akiisuka haguhi nabho, akabhakuniaku, akabhabhuurira, “Mwiimeerere, mutoobhoha!”
Hano bhaaramukirye ameeso gaabhu, bhakamurora Yeesu asaagiri omweene ego.
Hano bhaari kwiituuma mukiguru hayo, Yeesu akabhaswaagya, “Mutaaza kubhuurira muutu wowoosi gano muruuzi, tee eriibhaga rino enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, ndaaryookibhwe okurwa mubhaku.”
Abhaanabheega bhayo bhakamubhuurya, “Kwaki abheegya bhe emigiro gya Musa bharabhuga kubha, ereenderwa Eriya yiize hiinga niho Masiya yiize?”
Yeesu akabhakyoora, “Niigo eri, Eriya areenderwa yiize hiinga okubha atuure kisi amangʼana goosi.
Nawe ndabhabhuurira Eriya
amariri kuuza, nawe abhaatu bhataamumenyiri, bhakamukorera amabhi goosi gano bhakeenda. Egoego ne enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, ndanyaakibhwa mumabhoko gaabhu.”
Niho abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakamenyeekererya kubha Yeesu yaari arakeerenia iguru ya Yohana Omubatiizi.
Yeesu arahorya omwaana wuno ane eriisaambwa eriibhi
Hano Yeesu na abhaanabheega bhaaye bhaakyooriri hano haari ne esaango ya abhaatu, omuutu wumwe akaaza ku Yeesu, akahigama embere waaye.
Akamubhuurira Yeesu, “Ee Omukuru, ndasabha omurorere ebhigoongi omwaana waane! Ano obhurweeri bhwe eriirimu, no obhurweeri bhuyo bhuramunyaakya bhukongʼu. Maanga maaru aragwa mumuriro kasi mumaanzi.
Nikamuhira kubhaanabheega bhaazo okubha bhamuhorye, nawe bhakatamwa.”
Yeesu akabhuga, “Emwe abhaatu bho orwiibhuro runo, mutana obhwiikirirya, ndiikara neemwe tee ryoori? Ndabhiigumiirirya tee ryoori? Mumureete hano omwaana wuyo.”
Hano bhaamureetiri, Yeesu akaheebha eriisaambwa eriibhi rino ryaari muusi waaye, neeryo rikarwamu. Hayohayo, omwaana akahora.
Kyaamwe abhaanabheega bha Yeesu bhakamugyaku kibhezo, bhakamubhuurya, “Kwaki tukatamwa okuriheebha eriisaambwa rirya?”
Neewe akabhakyoora, “Ni kwe ekigirirye kyo obhwiikirirya bhweenyu bhutakwiisa. Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, eraabhe muungabheeri no obhwiikirirya bhusuuhu bhukongʼu kye etetere esuuhu bhukongʼu,
muungabhuuriiri ekiguru kino, ‘Noorwe hano, ogye harya,’ nakyo kiingagiiri. Kweego kitariho kigiro kino kitaari kuturikana kweemwe. [
Hamwe na gayo, eriisaambwa kya riyo mutakunagya kuriheebha, nawe kwe enzira yo okusabha Taatabhugya no okwiisiitya ebhyaakurya.]”
Yeesu arakeerenerya kweeki iguru yo okukwa no okuryooka kwaaye

Hano Yeesu yaari hamwe na abhaanabheega bhaaye mukyaaro kya Gariraaya, akabhabhuurira, “Enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, ndatuurwa mumabhoko ga abhaatu na bharaniita. Nawe kurusiku rwa katatu, Taatabhugya araniryoora.”
Hano abhaanabheega bhaaye bhiigwiiri gayo, bhakabha ne ebhigoongi bhukongʼu.
Yeesu arariha eriigooti rye eriiseengerero
Hano Yeesu na abhaanabheega bhaaye bhaahikiri mumugye gwa Kaperinaumu, abhaatu abharebhe bhano bhaari bharatobhya eriigooti kwiiguru we eriiseengerero rya Taatabhugya,
bhakaaza ku Petero. Bhakamubhuurya, “Awe, omweegya weenyu neewe araruusya eriigooti rye eriiseengerero rya Taatabhugya?”

Petero akabhakyoora, “Niigo eri, araruusya.” Niho akasikira munyuumba. Nawe Petero yaakyaari kugaamba engʼana yoyoosi, Yeesu akeema okumubhuurya, “Ee Simooni, awe orarorabhwi? Abhatemi bha mukyaaro kino bharatobhya eriigooti kubhaatu bhaabhu kasi kubhaatu bhaandi?”
Petero akamukyoora, “Bharatobhya kubhaandi.” Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Eraabhe niigo eri, ambe abhaana bhaabhu bhaabhiirwe kuriha eriigooti.

Nawe tutaaza tukabhabhiihirirya abhaatu bhano, awe noogye munyaanza, orekere endobho mumaanzi. Niho eswe yo okutaanga yino oraagwaate, oyitaanurye omunwa, orabhonamu orubhirya. Ogege orubhirya ruyo, ogye orihe eriigooti ryaane ne eryaazo.”

footnotes.text: Musa na Eriya bhaari abharooti abhakuru. Musa akabhakaangata Abhiiziraeri okurwa Misiri kugya Iziraeri. Na Eriya yaari bharamwiiseegera kubha arakyoora mukyaaro eriibhaga akyaari kuuza Masiya. Rora Maraaki 4:5.
Yeesu yaari aramuriingʼaania Eriya na Yohana Omubatiizi. Yohana akamukorera Yeesu enzira, emirimo Abhayahudi bhaari bhariisigira kubha Eriya woosi akore kyeego Yohana yakoriri.
Etetere esuuhu bhukongʼu ku Kiyunaani ni tetere ye eharadaari.

Eriibhaga riyo, Omuyahudi wowoosi omusubhe we emyaaka miroongo ebhiri (20) kasi kukiraho, yeendirwe kuriha eriigooti emyaaka gyoosi kwiiguru yo okukora eriiseengerero rya Taatabhugya. Eziimbirya ziyo zyaari kyeego amariho ge eziisiku ibhiri. Rora Okurwa 30:13-16; 2 Amangʼana ge Eriibhaga 24:9-14; Nehemia 10:32.
